Apache Guacamole common-js 1.6.0

Source: https://github.com/apache/guacamole-client/tree/1.6.0/guacamole-common-js

This bundle concatenates common/license.js and modules/*.js in filename order,
with the Maven project version placeholder set to 1.6.0. No runtime CDN is used.
Original Apache License and NOTICE are retained alongside the bundle.
